answer: Stop sybils with a vertex audit: an identity posts a bond at its vertex. It must then wander to three hosts in 7 days. Each host issues a whisper, a one-time device-bound proof. Verifiers void its whispers and slash the bond for any device at two hosts at once. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 bonds and 3,000 visits, 1,000× one honest agent, since a whisper cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents wander once and earn undiluted fees.
